apps.name: Clearline
apps.subtitle: Private offline-first task management for iPhone and Windows.
apps.localizedDescription: Clearline is a private, offline-first task manager with native iPhone integrations, widgets and controls, Share Sheet capture, Shortcuts/App Intents, reminders, calendar interoperability, and encrypted cross-device synchronization.

versions.localizedDescription: Extension-validated iPhone acceptance candidate. Built from dual-green source commit ef0f68e35d3508bd9ecc9e299acf2b72ec7f4d30. Compiled Widgets/Controls and Share extension metadata, display names, extension point identifiers, and Share principal class passed the remote installability gate before publication.
